hostedPage.title: Hosted page
hostedPage.intro: A page of your own on QuietJar, with your payment form open and ready. Share it anywhere you cannot embed the widget, like a GitHub README, a Reddit post or a social bio.
hostedPage.paymentsNotReady: Your page is live, but supporters cannot pay yet. Finish the payout setup first.
hostedPage.shareHint: Badges and links pointing here keep working as long as your handle stays the same.
hostedPage.handleHint: 3 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens.

handleStatus.invalid: Use 3 to 30 lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens.

hostedPage.handleConfirm:
Change your handle to @{handle}?

Your old page address stops working right away. Badges, READMEs and links you already pasted elsewhere will show a missing page until you update them.
hostedPage.displayNameHint: Who supporters are backing. Your name or your project's.
hostedPage.pageTitleHint: The ask, in one line. For example: Help keep this project maintained.
hostedPage.descriptionHint: A few sentences on what the money goes towards.
hostedPage.goalHint: Shows a progress bar on your page.
hostedPage.avatarHint: Square works best. PNG, JPEG or WebP. Large images are scaled down for you.
hostedPage.coverHint: A wide banner across the top, around 1500 by 500. PNG, JPEG or WebP. Large images are scaled down for you.
hostedPage.imageUnsupported: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
hostedPage.colorHint: Used for the payment button, the goal bar and links on your page.
hostedPage.loadFailed: Your hosted page could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
